messages.text: I wouldn’t confirm the $450 hall; it’s $150 over the agreed venue budget. The 30-seat room fits the 20 attendees and costs $240.

facts.quote: The Juniper group agreed on a total venue budget of $300. Only 20 people are attending. The 30-seat room costs $240, while the 80-seat hall costs $450. Both rooms are available for the meetup.
